from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from urllib.parse import urljoin
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import json,hashlib,re,requests
OUT=Path("reports/research/510300_corporate_loan_weighted_rate_source_qualification_v1")
jobs=[
{"quarter":"2022Q4","url":"https://www.pbc.gov.cn/zhengcehuobisi/125207/125227/125957/4584071/d7e45aa7d98c4664a9a6c2393d16787d/index.html"},
{"quarter":"2024Q4","url":"https://www.pbc.gov.cn/goutongjiaoliu/113456/113469/2025092212554550369/index.html"}
]
assert not (OUT/"release_probe_receipts.json").exists()
def probe(job):
    receipt={**job,"requested_at":datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat(),"attempts":1}
    try:
        r=requests.get(job["url"],headers={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"},timeout=(10,25))
        raw=r.content; assert len(raw)<4194304
        path=OUT/"sources"/("release_"+job["quarter"]+".html")
        assert not path.exists(); path.write_bytes(raw)
        receipt.update({"status_code":r.status_code,"final_url":r.url,"path":str(path).replace("\\","/"),
            "sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),"bytes":len(raw),"successfully_received":True})
        soup=BeautifulSoup(raw,"html.parser")
        receipt["title"]=soup.title.get_text(" ",strip=True) if soup.title else None
        body=soup.get_text(" ",strip=True)
        receipt["displayed_datetime_candidates"]=re.findall(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\s+\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}",body)
        links=[]
        for a in soup.find_all("a",href=True):
            title=a.get_text(" ",strip=True); href=urljoin(r.url,a["href"])
            if href.lower().split("?")[0].endswith(".pdf") or "货币政策执行报告" in title or re.fullmatch(r"202[2-5]年?",title):
                links.append({"title":title,"url":href})
        receipt["report_or_navigation_links"]=links
    except Exception as error:
        receipt.update({"successfully_received":False,"error_type":type(error).__name__,"error":str(error)})
    receipt["completed_at"]=datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
    return receipt
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool: receipts=list(pool.map(probe,jobs))
(OUT/"release_probe_receipts.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipts,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
for x in receipts:
    print(json.dumps({k:x.get(k) for k in ("quarter","status_code","title","displayed_datetime_candidates","report_or_navigation_links","error_type")},ensure_ascii=False)[:4600])
